scenicChapters.narrative: Speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through. 50 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it.

places-iza-kelemantia-rusovce-gerulata.story: A 296 km round trip from Komárom - roughly 5 h 06 in the saddle. On the way it passes Millenary Benedictine Abbey of Pannonhalma, Rusovce - Gerulata and back through Millenary Benedictine Abbey of Pannonhalma. It crosses from Hungary into Slovakia - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The line favours views over speed.
